environment: Isolated real TCP PostgreSQL, PostgREST, Supabase Auth and production Next.js A+ routes; controlled local Provider only
stop: Preserve and stop on the first meaningful product divergence; setup failures are invalid_run, never L1b pass

scenarios.name: Authenticated Turn and isolation
scenarios.expected: Real Auth session creates one durable Turn; exact create replay returns same ID; unauthenticated is 401; wrong owner/project read or mutate is 404; authenticated direct privileged RPC is denied

scenarios.name: Exact Text request and completed-result replay
scenarios.expected: One request ID/sequence/hash/Provider execution; exact completed replay returns same result; same request ID with changed Provider body returns 409 conflict and does not return the old result as if valid

scenarios.name: Durable client recovery
scenarios.expected: Real client persistence before POST; reload queries/redelivers original request; no second identity or paid POST grant

scenarios.name: Ambiguous execution
scenarios.expected: Uncertainty remains explicit; exact replay cannot acquire fresh execution; no new Provider submission

scenarios.name: Cancellation and late observation
scenarios.expected: Durable cancel intent; local abort does not prove Provider cancellation; late terminal observation preserves execution facts

scenarios.name: P3B escrow/redelivery/ACK
scenarios.expected: Complete immutable result; same-result GET; exact and duplicate ACK converge; conflicting identity/version/hash rejected; incomplete/unavailable/expired remain explicit; zero extra execution

scenarios.name: Compaction boundary
scenarios.expected: Exact action/request/source identity through real route/RPC; immutable result and no duplicate execution
